// Code generated by gocpy (Go bridge generator); DO NOT EDIT.
//
// This program runs with the user's Go toolchain inside the bridge module.
// It reads the exported API of the requested Go packages from compiler
// export data and writes
//   - bridge/bridge.go: the table of Go functions called through the bridge
//     (functions, methods, field accessors, variables, constructors);
//   - stubs/p<N>/<name>.gocpy: a Gocpy package per Go package;
//   - api.json: the list of packages.
//
// Requested packages get their full API. Packages whose types appear in it
// get stubs with these types (methods and fields) only.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"go/constant"
	"go/importer"
	"go/token"
	"go/types"
	"io"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

type request struct {
	Packages []string `json:"packages"`
}

var fset = token.NewFileSet()

func posOf(p token.Pos) string {
	if !p.IsValid() {
		return ""
	}
	pp := fset.Position(p)
	if pp.Filename == "" {
		return ""
	}
	file := pp.Filename
	if strings.HasPrefix(file, "$GOROOT") && goroot != "" {
		file = filepath.Join(goroot, strings.TrimPrefix(file, "$GOROOT"))
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d:%d", file, pp.Line, pp.Column)
}

var goroot = func() string {
	out, err := exec.Command("go", "env", "GOROOT").Output()
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	return strings.TrimSpace(string(out))
}()

func fail(f string, a ...any) {
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "gocpy go bridge: "+f+"\n", a...)
	os.Exit(1)
}

var errorType = types.Universe.Lookup("error").Type()

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- type model

// bt is the bridge view of a Go type.
type bt struct {
	k     string // bool int uint float string bytes error any iface named ptr list array map
	basic string // Gocpy basic type (int, uint and float kinds)
	elem  *bt
	key   *bt
	n     int64
	named *types.Named // iface, named, ptr (the element)
}

func (b *bt) id() string {
	switch b.k {
	case "int", "uint", "float":
		return b.basic
	case "iface", "named":
		return b.k + ":" + b.named.Obj().Pkg().Path() + "." + b.named.Obj().Name()
	case "ptr":
		return "*" + b.named.Obj().Pkg().Path() + "." + b.named.Obj().Name()
	case "list":
		return "[]" + b.elem.id()
	case "array":
		return fmt.Sprintf("[%d]%s", b.n, b.elem.id())
	case "map":
		return "map[" + b.key.id() + "]" + b.elem.id()
	}
	return b.k
}

// heavy: values that hold Go handles (kept alive across a call)
func (b *bt) heavy() bool {
	switch b.k {
	case "bool", "int", "uint", "float", "string", "bytes":
		return false
	}
	return true
}

var basicNames = map[types.BasicKind]string{
	types.Bool: "bool", types.Int: "int", types.Int8: "int8", types.Int16: "int16", types.Int32: "int32",
	types.Int64: "int64", types.Uint: "uint", types.Uint8: "uint8", types.Uint16: "uint16", types.Uint32: "uint32",
	types.Uint64: "uint64", types.Uintptr: "uintptr", types.Float32: "float32", types.Float64: "float64",
	types.String: "string",
}

func basicBT(b *types.Basic) (*bt, string) {
	name, ok := basicNames[b.Kind()]
	if !ok {
		switch b.Kind() {
		case types.Complex64, types.Complex128:
			return nil, "complex numbers are not supported"
		case types.UnsafePointer:
			return nil, "unsafe.Pointer is not supported"
		}
		return nil, fmt.Sprintf("type %s is not supported", b)
	}
	switch {
	case b.Kind() == types.Bool:
		return &bt{k: "bool"}, ""
	case b.Kind() == types.String:
		return &bt{k: "string"}, ""
	case b.Info()&types.IsFloat != 0:
		return &bt{k: "float", basic: name}, ""
	case b.Info()&types.IsUnsigned != 0:
		return &bt{k: "uint", basic: name}, ""
	}
	return &bt{k: "int", basic: name}, ""
}

func badPath(path string) bool {
	for _, el := range strings.Split(path, "/") {
		if el == "internal" || el == "vendor" {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// typeWhy reports why a named type cannot be bridged ("" if it can).
func typeWhy(n *types.Named) string {
	obj := n.Obj()
	if obj.Pkg() == nil {
		return fmt.Sprintf("type %s is not supported", n)
	}
	switch {
	case !obj.Exported():
		return fmt.Sprintf("unexported Go type %s", n)
	case n.TypeParams().Len() > 0 || n.TypeArgs().Len() > 0:
		return fmt.Sprintf("generic Go type %s is not supported", n)
	case badPath(obj.Pkg().Path()):
		return fmt.Sprintf("Go type %s is in an internal package", n)
	case obj.Name() == "Exception" || strings.HasPrefix(obj.Name(), "Gocpy"):
		return fmt.Sprintf("Go type %s clashes with a Gocpy name", n)
	case obj.Pkg().Name() == "main":
		return fmt.Sprintf("Go type %s is in a command", n)
	}
	return ""
}

type model struct {
	pkgs  map[string]*pkgInfo
	order []*pkgInfo
	queue []*types.Named
	seen  map[*types.Named]bool
}

type pkgInfo struct {
	pkg    *types.Package
	direct bool
	types  []*types.Named
	idx    int
}

func (m *model) info(p *types.Package) *pkgInfo {
	pi := m.pkgs[p.Path()]
	if pi == nil {
		pi = &pkgInfo{pkg: p, idx: len(m.order)}
		m.pkgs[p.Path()] = pi
		m.order = append(m.order, pi)
	}
	return pi
}

func (m *model) need(n *types.Named) {
	n = n.Origin()
	if m.seen[n] {
		return
	}
	m.seen[n] = true
	pi := m.info(n.Obj().Pkg())
	pi.types = append(pi.types, n)
	m.queue = append(m.queue, n)
}

// bt maps a Go type (and records the named types it needs).
func (m *model) bt(t types.Type) (*bt, string) {
	t = types.Unalias(t)
	if types.Identical(t, errorType) {
		return &bt{k: "error"}, ""
	}
	switch u := t.(type) {
	case *types.Named:
		if b, ok := u.Underlying().(*types.Basic); ok {
			return basicBT(b)
		}
		if why := typeWhy(u); why != "" {
			return nil, why
		}
		if it, ok := u.Underlying().(*types.Interface); ok {
			if it.Empty() {
				return &bt{k: "any"}, ""
			}
			m.need(u)
			return &bt{k: "iface", named: u}, ""
		}
		m.need(u)
		return &bt{k: "named", named: u}, ""
	case *types.Basic:
		return basicBT(u)
	case *types.Pointer:
		e, ok := types.Unalias(u.Elem()).(*types.Named)
		if !ok {
			return nil, fmt.Sprintf("pointer type %s is not supported", t)
		}
		switch e.Underlying().(type) {
		case *types.Basic:
			return nil, fmt.Sprintf("pointer type %s is not supported", t)
		case *types.Interface:
			return nil, fmt.Sprintf("pointer to an interface (%s) is not supported", t)
		}
		if why := typeWhy(e); why != "" {
			return nil, why
		}
		m.need(e)
		return &bt{k: "ptr", named: e}, ""
	case *types.Slice:
		if b, ok := types.Unalias(u.Elem()).(*types.Basic); ok && b.Kind() == types.Uint8 {
			return &bt{k: "bytes"}, ""
		}
		e, why := m.bt(u.Elem())
		if why != "" {
			return nil, why
		}
		return &bt{k: "list", elem: e}, ""
	case *types.Array:
		e, why := m.bt(u.Elem())
		if why != "" {
			return nil, why
		}
		return &bt{k: "array", elem: e, n: u.Len()}, ""
	case *types.Map:
		k, why := m.bt(u.Key())
		if why != "" {
			return nil, why
		}
		switch k.k {
		case "bool", "int", "uint", "float", "string":
		default:
			return nil, fmt.Sprintf("map type %s is not supported (keys must be basic types)", t)
		}
		e, why := m.bt(u.Elem())
		if why != "" {
			return nil, why
		}
		return &bt{k: "map", key: k, elem: e}, ""
	case *types.Interface:
		if u.Empty() {
			return &bt{k: "any"}, ""
		}
		return nil, fmt.Sprintf("unnamed interface type %s is not supported", t)
	case *types.Signature:
		return nil, "func values (callbacks) are not supported"
	case *types.Chan:
		return nil, "channels are not supported"
	case *types.Struct:
		return nil, "unnamed struct types are not supported"
	case *types.TypeParam:
		return nil, "generics are not supported"
	}
	return nil, fmt.Sprintf("type %s is not supported", t)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- API items

type param struct {
	name string
	t    *bt
}

type sigInfo struct {
	params   []param
	results  []*bt
	variadic bool
}

func (m *model) sig(s *types.Signature) (*sigInfo, string) {
	if s.TypeParams().Len() > 0 {
		return nil, "generic Go functions are not supported"
	}
	si := &sigInfo{variadic: s.Variadic()}
	for i := 0; i < s.Params().Len(); i++ {
		p := s.Params().At(i)
		b, why := m.bt(p.Type())
		if why != "" {
			return nil, fmt.Sprintf("parameter %d: %s", i+1, why)
		}
		si.params = append(si.params, param{p.Name(), b})
	}
	for i := 0; i < s.Results().Len(); i++ {
		b, why := m.bt(s.Results().At(i).Type())
		if why != "" {
			return nil, fmt.Sprintf("result %d: %s", i+1, why)
		}
		si.results = append(si.results, b)
	}
	return si, ""
}

// entry of the Go function table
type entry struct {
	goExpr string
}

type method struct {
	name string
	id   int
	sig  *sigInfo
	pos  string
}

type field struct {
	name     string
	t        *bt
	get, set int
	pos      string
}

type typeOut struct {
	n       *types.Named
	iface   bool
	methods []method
	fields  []field
	ctor    int // -1: none
	pos     string
}

type fnOut struct {
	name string
	id   int
	sig  *sigInfo
	pos  string
}

type varOut struct {
	name  string
	id    int
	t     *bt
	pos   string
	isErr bool
}

type cst struct {
	name, typ, value, pos string
}

type pkgOut struct {
	types  []*typeOut
	funcs  []fnOut
	vars   []varOut
	consts []cst
	// named basic types: aliases of the Gocpy basic types
	aliases []cst
	unsup   map[string]string
}

type gen struct {
	m       *model
	entries []entry
	imports map[string]string // Go path -> alias in bridge.go
	errVars []int
}

func (g *gen) qual(p *types.Package) string {
	if a, ok := g.imports[p.Path()]; ok {
		return a
	}
	a := fmt.Sprintf("p%d", len(g.imports))
	g.imports[p.Path()] = a
	return a
}

func (g *gen) goType(t types.Type) string { return types.TypeString(t, g.qual) }

func (g *gen) add(expr string) int {
	g.entries = append(g.entries, entry{expr})
	return len(g.entries) - 1
}

// storedAsPointer: Go values of this named type are kept as pointers to a
// copy (field getters return the address of the field instead).
func storedAsPointer(n *types.Named) bool {
	switch n.Underlying().(type) {
	case *types.Struct, *types.Array:
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func (g *gen) typeOut(n *types.Named, po *pkgOut) *typeOut {
	to := &typeOut{n: n, ctor: -1, pos: posOf(n.Obj().Pos())}
	qn := g.goType(n)
	tn := n.Obj().Name()
	if it, ok := n.Underlying().(*types.Interface); ok {
		to.iface = true
		for i := 0; i < it.NumMethods(); i++ {
			f := it.Method(i)
			if !f.Exported() {
				continue
			}
			si, why := g.m.sig(f.Type().(*types.Signature))
			if why != "" {
				po.unsup[tn+"."+f.Name()] = why
				continue
			}
			to.methods = append(to.methods, method{f.Name(), g.add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.%s", qn, f.Name())), si, posOf(f.Pos())})
		}
		return to
	}
	ms := types.NewMethodSet(types.NewPointer(n))
	names := map[string]bool{}
	for i := 0; i < ms.Len(); i++ {
		f := ms.At(i).Obj().(*types.Func)
		names[f.Name()] = true
		if !f.Exported() {
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(f.Name(), "Gocpy") {
			continue
		}
		si, why := g.m.sig(f.Type().(*types.Signature))
		if why != "" {
			po.unsup[tn+"."+f.Name()] = why
			continue
		}
		to.methods = append(to.methods, method{f.Name(), g.add(fmt.Sprintf("(*%s).%s", qn, f.Name())), si, posOf(f.Pos())})
	}
	switch n.Underlying().(type) {
	case *types.Struct:
		for _, f := range promotedFields(n) {
			if names[f.Name()] || strings.HasPrefix(f.Name(), "Gocpy") {
				continue
			}
			b, why := g.m.bt(f.Type())
			if why != "" {
				po.unsup[tn+"."+f.Name()] = why
				continue
			}
			ft := g.goType(f.Type())
			get := fmt.Sprintf("func(x *%s) %s { return x.%s }", qn, ft, f.Name())
			if fn, ok := types.Unalias(f.Type()).(*types.Named); ok && b.k == "named" && storedAsPointer(fn) {
				get = fmt.Sprintf("func(x *%s) *%s { return &x.%s }", qn, ft, f.Name())
			}
			fo := field{name: f.Name(), t: b, pos: posOf(f.Pos())}
			fo.get = g.add(get)
			fo.set = g.add(fmt.Sprintf("func(x *%s, v %s) { x.%s = v }", qn, ft, f.Name()))
			to.fields = append(to.fields, fo)
		}
		to.ctor = g.add(fmt.Sprintf("func() *%s { return new(%s) }", qn, qn))
	case *types.Map:
		to.ctor = g.add(fmt.Sprintf("func() *%s { v := make(%s); return &v }", qn, qn))
	case *types.Array:
		to.ctor = g.add(fmt.Sprintf("func() *%s { return new(%s) }", qn, qn))
	}
	return to
}

// promotedFields lists the exported fields of a struct type, including
// fields promoted from embedded structs (the shallowest unambiguous one).
func promotedFields(n *types.Named) []*types.Var {
	type level struct {
		t   types.Type
		via bool
	}
	var out []*types.Var
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	cur := []types.Type{n}
	visited := map[types.Type]bool{}
	for depth := 0; len(cur) > 0 && depth < 8; depth++ {
		count := map[string]int{}
		found := map[string]*types.Var{}
		var next []types.Type
		for _, t := range cur {
			if p, ok := t.(*types.Pointer); ok {
				t = p.Elem()
			}
			t = types.Unalias(t)
			if visited[t] {
				continue
			}
			visited[t] = true
			st, ok := t.Underlying().(*types.Struct)
			if !ok {
				continue
			}
			for i := 0; i < st.NumFields(); i++ {
				f := st.Field(i)
				count[f.Name()]++
				found[f.Name()] = f
				if f.Embedded() {
					next = append(next, f.Type())
				}
			}
		}
		var names []string
		for name := range found {
			names = append(names, name)
		}
		sort.Strings(names)
		for _, name := range names {
			if seen[name] {
				continue
			}
			seen[name] = true
			if count[name] == 1 && found[name].Exported() {
				out = append(out, found[name])
			}
		}
		cur = next
	}
	sort.SliceStable(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].Pos() < out[j].Pos() })
	return out
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- main

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		fail("usage: gen request.json")
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		fail("%v", err)
	}
	var req request
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &req); err != nil {
		fail("%v", err)
	}
	cmd := exec.Command("go", append([]string{"list", "-e", "-export", "-deps", "-json", "--"}, req.Packages...)...)
	cmd.Stderr = os.Stderr
	out, err := cmd.Output()
	if err != nil {
		fail("go list failed: %v", err)
	}
	exports := map[string]string{}
	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(out))
	var errs []string
	for dec.More() {
		var p struct {
			ImportPath string
			Export     string
			Error      *struct{ Err string }
		}
		if err := dec.Decode(&p); err != nil {
			fail("go list output: %v", err)
		}
		if p.Error != nil {
			errs = append(errs, p.Error.Err)
		}
		exports[p.ImportPath] = p.Export
	}
	if len(errs) > 0 {
		fail("%s", strings.Join(errs, "\n"))
	}
	imp := importer.ForCompiler(fset, "gc", func(path string) (io.ReadCloser, error) {
		f := exports[path]
		if f == "" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no export data for %s", path)
		}
		return os.Open(f)
	})

	m := &model{pkgs: map[string]*pkgInfo{}, seen: map[*types.Named]bool{}}
	g := &gen{m: m, imports: map[string]string{}}
	outs := map[*pkgInfo]*pkgOut{}
	pout := func(pi *pkgInfo) *pkgOut {
		po := outs[pi]
		if po == nil {
			po = &pkgOut{unsup: map[string]string{}}
			outs[pi] = po
		}
		return po
	}
	for _, path := range req.Packages {
		pkg, err := imp.Import(path)
		if err != nil {
			fail("import %s: %v", path, err)
		}
		if pkg.Name() == "main" {
			fail("%s is a Go command (package main), not a library", path)
		}
		pi := m.info(pkg)
		pi.direct = true
		po := pout(pi)
		names := pkg.Scope().Names()
		sort.Strings(names)
		for _, name := range names {
			obj := pkg.Scope().Lookup(name)
			if !obj.Exported() {
				continue
			}
			if name == "Exception" || strings.HasPrefix(name, "Gocpy") {
				po.unsup[name] = "the name clashes with a Gocpy name"
				continue
			}
			switch obj := obj.(type) {
			case *types.Func:
				si, why := m.sig(obj.Type().(*types.Signature))
				if why != "" {
					po.unsup[name] = why
					continue
				}
				id := g.add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.%s", g.qual(pkg), name))
				po.funcs = append(po.funcs, fnOut{name, id, si, posOf(obj.Pos())})
			case *types.Const:
				c, why := constDecl(obj)
				if why != "" {
					po.unsup[name] = why
					continue
				}
				po.consts = append(po.consts, c)
			case *types.TypeName:
				n, ok := obj.Type().(*types.Named)
				if !ok || obj.IsAlias() {
					if _, why := m.bt(obj.Type()); why != "" {
						po.unsup[name] = why
					} else {
						po.unsup[name] = "Go type aliases are not supported (use the original type)"
					}
					continue
				}
				if bb, isBasic := n.Underlying().(*types.Basic); isBasic {
					if bn, ok := basicNames[bb.Kind()]; ok {
						po.aliases = append(po.aliases, cst{name: name, typ: bn, pos: posOf(obj.Pos())})
					} else {
						po.unsup[name] = fmt.Sprintf("type %s is not supported", bb)
					}
					continue
				}
				if why := typeWhy(n); why != "" {
					po.unsup[name] = why
					continue
				}
				if it, ok := n.Underlying().(*types.Interface); ok && it.Empty() {
					po.unsup[name] = name + " is any in Gocpy"
					continue
				}
				m.need(n)
			case *types.Var:
				b, why := m.bt(obj.Type())
				if why != "" {
					po.unsup[name] = why
					continue
				}
				expr := fmt.Sprintf("func() %s { return %s.%s }", g.goType(obj.Type()), g.qual(pkg), name)
				if n, ok := types.Unalias(obj.Type()).(*types.Named); ok && b.k == "named" && storedAsPointer(n) {
					expr = fmt.Sprintf("func() *%s { return &%s.%s }", g.goType(obj.Type()), g.qual(pkg), name)
				}
				id := g.add(expr)
				if b.k == "error" {
					g.errVars = append(g.errVars, id)
				}
				po.vars = append(po.vars, varOut{name, id, b, posOf(obj.Pos()), b.k == "error"})
			}
		}
	}
	// the closure of named types
	done := map[*types.Named]*typeOut{}
	for len(m.queue) > 0 {
		n := m.queue[0]
		m.queue = m.queue[1:]
		pi := m.pkgs[n.Obj().Pkg().Path()]
		po := pout(pi)
		to := g.typeOut(n, po)
		done[n] = to
		po.types = append(po.types, to)
	}

	writeBridge(g)
	var api []map[string]any
	for _, pi := range m.order {
		po := pout(pi)
		rel := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join("stubs", fmt.Sprintf("p%d", pi.idx), pi.pkg.Name()+".gocpy"))
		src := stubSource(m, pi, po)
		p := filepath.FromSlash(rel)
		os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0o755)
		if err := os.WriteFile(p, []byte(src), 0o644); err != nil {
			fail("%v", err)
		}
		api = append(api, map[string]any{"path": pi.pkg.Path(), "name": pi.pkg.Name(), "stub": rel, "unsupported": po.unsup, "direct": pi.direct})
	}
	js, _ := json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{"packages": api, "functions": len(g.entries)}, "", "  ")
	if err := os.WriteFile("api.json", js, 0o644); err != nil {
		fail("%v", err)
	}
}

func writeBridge(g *gen) {
	var src bytes.Buffer
	var table strings.Builder
	for i, e := range g.entries {
		fmt.Fprintf(&table, "\t/* %d */ reflect.ValueOf(%s),\n", i, e.goExpr)
	}
	src.WriteString("// Code generated by gocpy (Go bridge); DO NOT EDIT.\npackage main\n\nimport (\n\t\"reflect\"\n")
	var paths []string
	for p := range g.imports {
		paths = append(paths, p)
	}
	sort.Strings(paths)
	for _, p := range paths {
		a := g.imports[p]
		if regexp.MustCompile(`\b` + a + `\.`).MatchString(table.String()) {
			fmt.Fprintf(&src, "\t%s %q\n", a, p)
		}
	}
	src.WriteString(")\n\nvar fns = []reflect.Value{\n")
	src.WriteString(table.String())
	src.WriteString("}\n\n// variables of type error (their values are compared by identity)\nvar errVars = map[int]bool{")
	for i, id := range g.errVars {
		if i > 0 {
			src.WriteString(", ")
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(&src, "%d: true", id)
	}
	src.WriteString("}\n")
	if err := os.MkdirAll("bridge", 0o755); err != nil {
		fail("%v", err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join("bridge", "bridge.go"), src.Bytes(), 0o644); err != nil {
		fail("%v", err)
	}
}

func constDecl(obj *types.Const) (cst, string) {
	c := cst{name: obj.Name(), pos: posOf(obj.Pos())}
	t := obj.Type()
	b, ok := t.Underlying().(*types.Basic)
	if !ok {
		return c, "unsupported constant type"
	}
	if b.Info()&types.IsUntyped == 0 {
		gt, ok := basicNames[b.Kind()]
		if !ok {
			return c, fmt.Sprintf("constant of type %s is not supported by the bridge", t)
		}
		c.typ = gt
	}
	v := obj.Val()
	switch v.Kind() {
	case constant.Bool:
		c.value = strconv.FormatBool(constant.BoolVal(v))
	case constant.String:
		c.value = strconv.Quote(constant.StringVal(v))
	case constant.Int:
		c.value = v.ExactString()
	case constant.Float:
		f, _ := constant.Float64Val(v)
		s := strconv.FormatFloat(f, 'g', -1, 64)
		if !strings.ContainsAny(s, ".eEn") {
			s += ".0"
		}
		c.value = s
	default:
		return c, "complex constants are not supported"
	}
	return c, ""
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Gocpy stubs

const goPos = "// go:pos "

// reserved: Gocpy keywords and predeclared names (shadowing is forbidden).
var reserved = map[string]bool{}

func init() {
	for _, k := range strings.Fields(`break case chan const continue default defer else fallthrough for func go
		if import in interface map package range return select struct switch type var try catch finally throw unsafe
		bool byte rune int int8 int16 int32 int64 uint uint8 uint16 uint32 uint64 uintptr float32 float64 string any
		error Exception comparable true false nil iota len cap append make new sizeof close delete thread
		malloc calloc realloc free memcpy memset slice errors gobridge`) {
		reserved[k] = true
	}
}

type stub struct {
	m       *model
	pi      *pkgInfo
	aliases map[string]string // Go path -> alias
	used    map[string]bool
	top     map[string]bool
	helpers map[string]string // bt id -> helper suffix
	hb      strings.Builder
	nhelp   int
}

func (s *stub) qual(n *types.Named) string {
	p := n.Obj().Pkg()
	if p.Path() == s.pi.pkg.Path() {
		return n.Obj().Name()
	}
	a, ok := s.aliases[p.Path()]
	if !ok {
		base := p.Name()
		a = base
		for i := 2; s.used[a] || reserved[a] || a == s.pi.pkg.Name(); i++ {
			a = fmt.Sprintf("%s%d", base, i)
		}
		s.used[a] = true
		s.aliases[p.Path()] = a
	}
	return a + "." + n.Obj().Name()
}

func (s *stub) spell(b *bt) string {
	switch b.k {
	case "int", "uint", "float":
		return b.basic
	case "bytes":
		return "[]byte"
	case "iface", "named":
		return s.qual(b.named)
	case "ptr":
		return "*" + s.qual(b.named)
	case "list":
		return "[]" + s.spell(b.elem)
	case "array":
		return fmt.Sprintf("[%d]%s", b.n, s.spell(b.elem))
	case "map":
		return "map[" + s.spell(b.key) + "]" + s.spell(b.elem)
	}
	return b.k // bool string error any
}

// implName: the Gocpy type used for Go values of an interface type whose
// dynamic type has no Gocpy counterpart.
func (s *stub) implName(n *types.Named) string {
	q := s.qual(n)
	if i := strings.LastIndex(q, "."); i >= 0 {
		return q[:i+1] + "GocpyImpl_" + q[i+1:]
	}
	return "GocpyImpl_" + q
}

// enc returns a statement encoding x into e.
func (s *stub) enc(b *bt, x, e string) string {
	switch b.k {
	case "bool":
		return fmt.Sprintf("%s.Bool(%s)", e, x)
	case "int":
		return fmt.Sprintf("%s.Int(int64(%s))", e, x)
	case "uint":
		return fmt.Sprintf("%s.Uint(uint64(%s))", e, x)
	case "float":
		return fmt.Sprintf("%s.Float(float64(%s))", e, x)
	case "string":
		return fmt.Sprintf("%s.String(%s)", e, x)
	case "bytes":
		return fmt.Sprintf("%s.Bytes(%s)", e, x)
	case "error":
		return fmt.Sprintf("%s.Err(%s)", e, x)
	case "any":
		return fmt.Sprintf("%s.Any(%s)", e, x)
	case "iface":
		return fmt.Sprintf("%s.Handle(gobridge.HandleOf(%s))", e, x)
	case "named":
		return fmt.Sprintf("%s.Handle(%s.GocpyRef.H())", e, x)
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("gocpyEnc%s(%s, %s)", s.helper(b), e, x)
}

// dec returns an expression decoding a value from d.
func (s *stub) dec(b *bt, d string) string {
	switch b.k {
	case "bool":
		return d + ".Bool()"
	case "int":
		if b.basic == "int64" {
			return d + ".Int()"
		}
		return fmt.Sprintf("%s(%s.Int())", b.basic, d)
	case "uint":
		if b.basic == "uint64" {
			return d + ".Uint()"
		}
		return fmt.Sprintf("%s(%s.Uint())", b.basic, d)
	case "float":
		if b.basic == "float64" {
			return d + ".Float()"
		}
		return fmt.Sprintf("%s(%s.Float())", b.basic, d)
	case "string":
		return d + ".String()"
	case "bytes":
		return d + ".Bytes()"
	case "error":
		return d + ".Err()"
	case "any":
		return d + ".Any()"
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("gocpyDec%s(%s)", s.helper(b), d)
}

// helper emits (once) the encoder and decoder functions of a composite type.
func (s *stub) helper(b *bt) string {
	id := b.id()
	if h, ok := s.helpers[id]; ok {
		return h
	}
	s.nhelp++
	h := fmt.Sprintf("_%d", s.nhelp)
	s.helpers[id] = h
	t := s.spell(b)
	w := &s.hb
	switch b.k {
	case "named":
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "\nfunc gocpyDec%s(d *gobridge.Decoder) %s {\n\th, _ := d.Handle()\n\treturn %s{GocpyRef: gobridge.NewRef(h)}\n}\n", h, t, t)
	case "ptr":
		q := s.qual(b.named)
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "\nfunc gocpyEnc%s(e *gobridge.Encoder, v %s) {\n\tif v == nil {\n\t\te.Handle(0)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.Handle(v.GocpyRef.H())\n}\n", h, t)
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "\nfunc gocpyDec%s(d *gobridge.Decoder) %s {\n\th, _ := d.Handle()\n\tif h == 0 {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\treturn &%s{GocpyRef: gobridge.NewRef(h)}\n}\n", h, t, q)
	case "iface":
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "\nfunc gocpyDec%s(d *gobridge.Decoder) %s {\n\th, name := d.Handle()\n\tif h == 0 {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\tr := gobridge.NewRef(h)\n\tv := gobridge.Make(r, name)\n\tif x, ok := v.(%s); ok {\n\t\treturn x\n\t}\n\treturn %s{GocpyRef: r}\n}\n", h, t, t, s.implName(b.named))
	case "list":
		et := s.spell(b.elem)
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "\nfunc gocpyEnc%s(e *gobridge.Encoder, v %s) {\n\te.Len(len(v))\n\tfor i := 0; i < len(v); i++ {\n\t\t%s\n\t}\n}\n", h, t, s.enc(b.elem, "v[i]", "e"))
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "\nfunc gocpyDec%s(d *gobridge.Decoder) %s {\n\tn := d.Len()\n\tif n == 0 {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\tout := make([]%s, n)\n\tfor i := 0; i < n; i++ {\n\t\tout[i] = %s\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n", h, t, et, s.dec(b.elem, "d"))
	case "array":
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "\nfunc gocpyEnc%s(e *gobridge.Encoder, v %s) {\n\tfor i := 0; i < %d; i++ {\n\t\t%s\n\t}\n}\n", h, t, b.n, s.enc(b.elem, "v[i]", "e"))
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "\nfunc gocpyDec%s(d *gobridge.Decoder) %s {\n\tvar out %s\n\tfor i := 0; i < %d; i++ {\n\t\tout[i] = %s\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n", h, t, t, b.n, s.dec(b.elem, "d"))
	case "map":
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "\nfunc gocpyEnc%s(e *gobridge.Encoder, v %s) {\n\te.Len(len(v))\n\tfor k, x in v {\n\t\t%s\n\t\t%s\n\t}\n}\n", h, t, s.enc(b.key, "k", "e"), s.enc(b.elem, "x", "e"))
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "\nfunc gocpyDec%s(d *gobridge.Decoder) %s {\n\tn := d.Len()\n\tout := %s{}\n\tfor i := 0; i < n; i++ {\n\t\tk := %s\n\t\tout[k] = %s\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n", h, t, t, s.dec(b.key, "d"), s.dec(b.elem, "d"))
	}
	return h
}

func resultList(rs []string) string {
	switch len(rs) {
	case 0:
		return ""
	case 1:
		return " " + rs[0]
	}
	return " (" + strings.Join(rs, ", ") + ")"
}

// names picks readable, non-conflicting parameter names.
func (s *stub) names(ps []param) []string {
	var out []string
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for i, p := range ps {
		n := p.name
		if n == "" || n == "_" || seen[n] || s.top[n] || reserved[n] || strings.HasPrefix(n, "gocpy") || s.pkgName(n) {
			n = fmt.Sprintf("a%d", i)
			for seen[n] || s.top[n] {
				n += "_"
			}
		}
		seen[n] = true
		out = append(out, n)
	}
	return out
}

// pkgName: n may be the alias of an imported package in some stub.
func (s *stub) pkgName(n string) bool {
	for _, pi := range s.m.order {
		if pi.pkg.Name() == n {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// sigText: "(a T, b ...U) (R, error)"
func (s *stub) sigText(si *sigInfo, names []string) string {
	var ps []string
	for i, p := range si.params {
		t := s.spell(p.t)
		if si.variadic && i == len(si.params)-1 {
			t = "..." + s.spell(p.t.elem)
			if p.t.k == "bytes" {
				t = "...byte"
			}
		}
		if names != nil {
			ps = append(ps, names[i]+" "+t)
		} else {
			ps = append(ps, t)
		}
	}
	var rs []string
	for _, r := range si.results {
		rs = append(rs, s.spell(r))
	}
	return "(" + strings.Join(ps, ", ") + ")" + resultList(rs)
}

// body of a stub function calling Go function id.
func (s *stub) body(w *strings.Builder, id int, recv string, ps []param, names []string, results []*bt) {
	w.WriteString("\tgocpyE := gobridge.NewEncoder()\n")
	if recv != "" {
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "\tgocpyE.Handle(%s.GocpyRef.H())\n", recv)
	}
	for i, p := range ps {
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "\t%s\n", s.enc(p.t, names[i], "gocpyE"))
	}
	if len(results) == 0 {
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "\tgobridge.Invoke(%d, gocpyE)\n", id)
	} else {
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "\tgocpyD := gobridge.Invoke(%d, gocpyE)\n", id)
	}
	var rs []string
	for i, r := range results {
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "\tgocpyR%d := %s\n", i, s.dec(r, "gocpyD"))
		rs = append(rs, fmt.Sprintf("gocpyR%d", i))
	}
	if recv != "" {
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "\tgobridge.KeepAlive(%s)\n", recv)
	}
	for i, p := range ps {
		if p.t.heavy() {
			fmt.Fprintf(w, "\tgobridge.KeepAlive(%s)\n", names[i])
		}
	}
	if len(rs) > 0 {
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "\treturn %s\n", strings.Join(rs, ", "))
	}
}

func pos(w *strings.Builder, p string) {
	if p != "" {
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "%s%s\n", goPos, p)
	}
}

func typePath(n *types.Named) string { return n.Obj().Pkg().Path() + "." + n.Obj().Name() }

func stubSource(m *model, pi *pkgInfo, po *pkgOut) string {
	s := &stub{m: m, pi: pi, aliases: map[string]string{}, used: map[string]bool{"gobridge": true}, top: map[string]bool{}, helpers: map[string]string{}}
	for _, t := range po.types {
		s.top[t.n.Obj().Name()] = true
		s.top["GocpyImpl_"+t.n.Obj().Name()] = true
	}
	for _, f := range po.funcs {
		s.top[f.name] = true
	}
	for _, v := range po.vars {
		s.top[v.name] = true
	}
	for _, c := range po.consts {
		s.top[c.name] = true
	}
	for _, c := range po.aliases {
		s.top[c.name] = true
	}
	// aliases first, so that parameter names do not clash with them
	var body strings.Builder
	w := &body
	for _, c := range po.aliases {
		w.WriteString("\n")
		pos(w, c.pos)
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "// %s is %s in Gocpy (methods of named basic Go types are not available).\ntype %s = %s\n", c.name, c.typ, c.name, c.typ)
	}
	for _, c := range po.consts {
		w.WriteString("\n")
		pos(w, c.pos)
		if c.typ != "" {
			fmt.Fprintf(w, "const %s %s = %s\n", c.name, c.typ, c.value)
		} else {
			fmt.Fprintf(w, "const %s = %s\n", c.name, c.value)
		}
	}
	for _, t := range po.types {
		t := t
		name := t.n.Obj().Name()
		if t.iface {
			w.WriteString("\n")
			pos(w, t.pos)
			fmt.Fprintf(w, "type %s interface {\n", name)
			for _, mt := range t.methods {
				fmt.Fprintf(w, "\t%s%s\n", mt.name, s.sigText(mt.sig, nil))
			}
			w.WriteString("\tGocpyHandle() uint64\n}\n")
			fmt.Fprintf(w, "\n// GocpyImpl_%s holds Go values of the interface %s.\ntype GocpyImpl_%s struct {\n\tGocpyRef *gobridge.Ref\n}\n", name, name, name)
			fmt.Fprintf(w, "\nfunc (gocpyX GocpyImpl_%s) GocpyHandle() uint64 {\n\treturn gocpyX.GocpyRef.H()\n}\n", name)
			for _, mt := range t.methods {
				mt := mt
				names := s.names(mt.sig.params)
				fmt.Fprintf(w, "\n")
				pos(w, mt.pos)
				fmt.Fprintf(w, "func (gocpyX GocpyImpl_%s) %s%s {\n", name, mt.name, s.sigText(mt.sig, names))
				s.body(w, mt.id, "gocpyX", mt.sig.params, names, mt.sig.results)
				w.WriteString("}\n")
			}
			continue
		}
		w.WriteString("\n")
		pos(w, t.pos)
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "type %s struct {\n\tGocpyRef *gobridge.Ref\n}\n", name)
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "\nvar gocpyReg_%s = gobridge.Register(%q, func(r *gobridge.Ref) any { return &%s{GocpyRef: r} })\n", name, "*"+typePath(t.n), name)
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "var gocpyRegV_%s = gobridge.Register(%q, func(r *gobridge.Ref) any { return %s{GocpyRef: r} })\n", name, typePath(t.n), name)
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "\n// GocpyHandle returns the handle of the Go value.\nfunc (gocpyX %s) GocpyHandle() uint64 {\n\treturn gocpyX.GocpyRef.H()\n}\n", name)
		if t.ctor >= 0 {
			fmt.Fprintf(w, "\n// GocpyNew_%s returns a new zero Go value.\nfunc GocpyNew_%s() *%s {\n\tgocpyD := gobridge.Invoke(%d, gobridge.NewEncoder())\n\th, _ := gocpyD.Handle()\n\treturn &%s{GocpyRef: gobridge.NewRef(h)}\n}\n", name, name, name, t.ctor, name)
		}
		for _, mt := range t.methods {
			names := s.names(mt.sig.params)
			w.WriteString("\n")
			pos(w, mt.pos)
			fmt.Fprintf(w, "func (gocpyX %s) %s%s {\n", name, mt.name, s.sigText(mt.sig, names))
			s.body(w, mt.id, "gocpyX", mt.sig.params, names, mt.sig.results)
			w.WriteString("}\n")
		}
		for _, f := range t.fields {
			ft := s.spell(f.t)
			w.WriteString("\n")
			pos(w, f.pos)
			fmt.Fprintf(w, "func (gocpyX %s) GocpyGet_%s() %s {\n", name, f.name, ft)
			s.body(w, f.get, "gocpyX", nil, nil, []*bt{f.t})
			w.WriteString("}\n\n")
			pos(w, f.pos)
			fmt.Fprintf(w, "func (gocpyX %s) GocpySet_%s(v %s) {\n", name, f.name, ft)
			s.body(w, f.set, "gocpyX", []param{{"v", f.t}}, []string{"v"}, nil)
			w.WriteString("}\n")
		}
	}
	for i, v := range po.vars {
		w.WriteString("\n")
		pos(w, v.pos)
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "var %s %s = gocpyVar_%d()\n", v.name, s.spell(v.t), i)
		if v.isErr {
			fmt.Fprintf(w, "var gocpySent_%d = gobridge.Sentinel(%d, %s)\n", i, v.id, v.name)
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "\nfunc gocpyVar_%d() %s {\n", i, s.spell(v.t))
		s.body(w, v.id, "", nil, nil, []*bt{v.t})
		w.WriteString("}\n")
	}
	for _, f := range po.funcs {
		names := s.names(f.sig.params)
		w.WriteString("\n")
		pos(w, f.pos)
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "func %s%s {\n", f.name, s.sigText(f.sig, names))
		s.body(w, f.id, "", f.sig.params, names, f.sig.results)
		w.WriteString("}\n")
	}

	var out strings.Builder
	fmt.Fprintf(&out, "// Code generated by gocpy from Go package %q; DO NOT EDIT.\npackage %s\n\nimport (\n", pi.pkg.Path(), pi.pkg.Name())
	if strings.Contains(body.String(), "gobridge.") || strings.Contains(s.hb.String(), "gobridge.") {
		out.WriteString("\t\"std/gobridge\"\n")
	}
	var paths []string
	for p := range s.aliases {
		paths = append(paths, p)
	}
	sort.Strings(paths)
	for _, p := range paths {
		fmt.Fprintf(&out, "\t%s %q\n", s.aliases[p], p)
	}
	out.WriteString(")\n")
	out.WriteString(body.String())
	out.WriteString(s.hb.String())
	return out.String()
}
